name_en: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship - Public Examination Fee for 10th and 12th Std.
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
benefit: If you are writing the Class 10 or Class 12 public exam, the government pays your full exam fee. You do not pay it. There is no income limit.

other: Must be writing the 10th or 12th public exam

how_to_apply: Students or parents meet the school Headmaster with the papers. The school handles it.
where_to_apply: At your school, through the Headmaster

evidence.quote: by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
Full reimbursement on Public Examination fee for 10th and 12th Std. students.
There is no income limit for eligibility under this scheme.
The beneficiary should be a Student.
The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity community.
The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
The beneficiary must be appearing for public examinations of 10th/12th Std.
Proof of identity (Aadhar card or any other document as directed by the authority).
Caste certificate Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity community).
Students/ Guardians should contact the Headmaster of the School with all the required documents
Students must apply through the headmaster of their respective schools.

gaps: Source does not say which schools are covered (government, aided or private).
Source gives no rupee amount; it says the full fee is paid to the Directorate of Government Examinations.
Source gives no helpline, G.O. number or Tamil name. myScheme page is undated.
